product_one_liner.value: Wellinks provides virtual cardiopulmonary chronic care and remote patient monitoring for people with COPD and other cardiopulmonary conditions, helping health plans and providers identify deterioration and intervene earlier.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page found; the commercial inquiry page offers a contact form rather than plans or pricing.

value: Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield Delaware
named_customers.notes: These organizations have announced delivery of Wellinks care to their members or patient networks; the sources do not disclose contract values. SoNE is described as a care-delivery collaboration, rather than explicitly labeled a customer.

founded_year.notes: Company profile founding year; the legal entity is Convexity Scientific, doing business as Wellinks.

eng_blog.notes: The readable content index contains clinical, company and marketing content, not two engineer-authored accounts of product construction.

public_docs.notes: Public knowledge base includes app/device support, password reset, readings, action plans and other support articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed Senior Data and BI Analyst role does not qualify under the requested title criteria.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed product and predictive-care descriptions, the AI case study, public support documentation and privacy/legal materials; no specific AI model or model provider was disclosed, and no public subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims HIPAA-compliant telehealth connections and covered-entity privacy practices; HIPAA is a compliance claim, not an independently issued certification.

last_funding.notes: First close announced August 4, 2026; the Series B label follows the company’s announcement even though an earlier 2021 round was called Series C.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable job board lists Senior Data and BI Analyst, not an SDR, BDR or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: No major product or feature launch found during May 9–November 9, 2026. Predictive Patient Care is described in November 2024; the Spire combination was announced September 30, 2024. Later funding, appointments and care deployments are not new product launches.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The August 31, 2026 announcement adds Stephanie Solich as VP Customer Success and announces VP appointments for Stephanie Willard and Andrew Brimer; this is within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job posting names technical analytics tools but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
